about: Additional fictional cases. Kept separate from the original benchmark so historical results remain comparable. Expected answers were written before running the stubs.

cases.source: Your quote request was received on 15 October. Pricing will follow after review.
cases.note: A date is not an order quantity or a quoted price.

cases.source: The quote expires in 30 days. The rate has not been supplied.
cases.note: Validity duration is not the order quantity.

cases.source: Last year's unrelated customer paid INR 2400. We have not agreed your rate.
cases.note: A quoted price belonging to another customer is not the current price.

cases.source: Please review this offer and tell us whether you accept it.
cases.note: The literal word accept appears in a question. It is not an acceptance.

cases.source: Indicative cost is between INR 2000 and INR 3000. A fixed quote will follow.
cases.note: A range must not silently become a single agreed unit price.
A real zero fee is evidence. Missing data is a different state.

cases.source: Buyer budget is INR 4000 per session. The seller has not quoted a rate.
cases.note: The buyer's spending limit must not become the seller's quote.

cases.source: Application received. Approval is pending and no amount has been awarded.
cases.note: Acknowledgement is not approval or an awarded amount.
